definitions.explanation: A state of heightened emotion or enthusiasm.
A state of being emotionally stirred up.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}を{見|み}て{興奮|こうふん}した。
examples.english: I got excited watching the game.

examples.japanese: {興奮|こうふん}して{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I was so excited that I couldn't sleep.

examples.japanese: {興奮|こうふん}を{抑|おさ}えられない。
コンサート{会場|かいじょう}は{興奮|こうふん}に{包|つつ}まれていた。ファンたちは{最後|さいご}まで{立|た}ち{上|あ}がって{声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: The concert venue was filled with excitement. Fans stood up and cheered until the very end.

notes:
{興奮|こうふん} describes a state of excitement or agitation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {興奮|こうふん}する (to get excited)
- {興奮|こうふん}させる (to excite someone)
- {興奮|こうふん}が{冷|さ}める (excitement subsides)
- {興奮|こうふん}を{抑|おさ}える (to control one's excitement)

DESCRIPTIVE USES:
- {興奮|こうふん}した{様子|ようす} (excited manner)
- {興奮|こうふん}{状態|じょうたい} (state of excitement)
- {興奮|こうふん}{気味|ぎみ} (somewhat excited)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{興奮|こうふん} (great excitement)
- {性的|せいてき}{興奮|こうふん} (sexual arousal)
